reviewer.name: automated visual review of rendered slides

review_context.method: each slide image inspected at full resolution for clipping, overlap, alignment and legibility; slide 5 and slide 7 values checked against facts/ and results/stats.json

findings.message: Table index strip repeats the column headers; template accessibility metadata.
Confidence value wraps inside the left card; fully legible, lower third empty.
Two PyMOL panels with subfigure labels A and B; caption states each panel is oriented on its own ligand.
Named per-system table renders four rows; CDK2 Boltz-2 reads 6 of 9 wild type against 1 perturbed; FtsE perturbed medoids 16.401 and 17.821 A, matching the fact files.
Decision grid legible at panel size; row labels and prediction names readable.
Aggregate chart with legend above the axes; three sidebar sections fit the rail; counts moved to the caption.
Two cards with headings aligned and one-line bullets; empty band below.
